title: Sayaji Baug (Kamati Baug): The Green Heart of Vadodara
content:
Sayaji Baug (Kamati Baug), Vadodara

If Laxmi Vilas Palace is Vadodara’s royal crown, then Sayaji Baug, also known as Kamati Baug, is its emerald gem. Spread across over 100 acres, this lush public park is one of Gujarat’s most beautiful green spaces - blending nature, history, and learning into one memorable experience.

A Gift from the Maharaja

Sayaji Baug was built in 1879 by Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad III, one of the most visionary rulers of the Gaekwad dynasty. The park was named after him and created for the enjoyment of all citizens - a reflection of his progressive ideals. Locals fondly call it Kamati Baug, after the community that once lived nearby.

What to See Inside

Sayaji Baug isn’t just a park - it’s a mini world of attractions. Here’s what you can find within its beautifully landscaped grounds:

1. Baroda Museum & Picture Gallery

Established in 1894, this museum houses fascinating art, archaeological treasures, and rare exhibits from across the world — including Egyptian mummies, Mughal miniatures, and European paintings.

2. Sayaji Baug Zoo

A favorite among families and children, the zoo is home to lions, tigers, deer, and various birds. It’s one of India’s oldest zoos and continues to expand its conservation efforts.

3. Sardar Patel Planetarium

For science lovers, the planetarium offers daily 3D shows about space and astronomy, inspiring young minds to look up at the stars.

4. Toy Train Ride

A nostalgic highlight! The toy train chugs through the park’s scenic routes, offering fun rides for both kids and adults.

5. Floral Gardens & Fountains

The park’s botanical beauty comes alive with seasonal flowers, fountains, and tree-lined walkways -  perfect for a peaceful evening stroll.

Visitor Information

  • Location: Sayajigunj, Vadodara, Gujarat
  • Timings: 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM (daily)
  • Entry Fee: Free (nominal charges for zoo, museum, and planetarium)
  • Best Time to Visit: October - March (pleasant weather for outdoor walks)

Nearby Attractions

  • Laxmi Vilas Palace - 2 km
  • Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum - 2 km
  • Sursagar Lake - 3 km

Best time to visit Sayaji Baug (Kamati Baug):

October to March, when the weather in Vadodara is pleasant and cool, ideal for walking through the gardens, enjoying the zoo, and exploring outdoor attractions comfortably.
excerpt: Sayaji Baug (Kamati Baug) in Vadodara is a sprawling 100-acre public park featuring a zoo, Baroda Museum, planetarium, and scenic gardens. Built by Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad III, it blends nature, history, and family-friendly attractions. A must-visit spot for tourists and locals alike.
